2105-5895-7296-8330.easyPrerequisites: Combat Celebrant hasn't been exerted this turn.
2105-5895-7296-8330.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2105-5895-7296-8330.description:
Cast Massimo by paying its mana cost plus commander tax if applicable.
When Massimo enters, it triggers, exiling Splash Portal from your graveyard and giving Massimo the listed ability.
Declare Massimo and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage with Massimo. Its ability triggers, casting a copy of Splash Portal from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Splash Portal, blinking Combat Celebrant.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

396-539-728-3249--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
396-539-728-3249--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Ashaya by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Ashaya by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the creature castable for one mana from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature spell from your graveyard by paying it mana cost.
When you cast that creature or when it enters, Blessed Sanctuary triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

728-1636-2527-3143.notablePrerequisites:
There is at least one counter on a permanent you control except Xavier Sal.
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional nontoken Human, Fungus and/or Pirate that has no more than one +1/+1 counter on it.
728-1636-2527-3143.description:
Activate Xavier Sal's first ability by tapping it and removing a +1/+1 counter from the additional nontoken Human, Fungus and/or Pirate if it has one, or any counter from another permanent you control otherwise.
Xavier Sal triggers, causing it and all other creatures you control that share a creature type with it to get +2/+0 and gain undying until end of turn.
Resolve the Xavier Sal ability, causing you to populate.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the additional Human, Fungus and/or Pirate.
When the creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

640-1981-2415-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Dross Harvester and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Dross Harvester trigger, causing you to gain 2 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing it to become a Spirit artifact creature in addition to its other types until end of turn.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more +1/+1 counters on it

2122-4029-6822.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw a card.
Lyla triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Mindless Automaton due to Benevolent Hydra
Repeat.

924-4149-4599-4871-7175.easyPrerequisites: Gravespawn Sovereign is untapped or you control another untapped Zombie.
924-4149-4599-4871-7175.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three additional creatures.
924-4149-4599-4871-7175.description:
Activate Phyrexian Ghoul by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phyrexian Ghoul ability, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat steps 1 through 3 two additional times.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Ghoulcaller Gisa by paying {B}, tapping it and sacrificing Phyrexian Ghoul.
When Phyrexian Ghoul dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Ghoulcaller Gisa ability, creating eight 2/2 Zombie creature tokens.
Activate Gravespawn Sovereign by tapping five Zombies, returning Phyrexian Ghoul from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Phyrexian Ghoul by sacrificing Ghoulcaller Gisa.
When Ghoulcaller Gisa dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phyrexian Ghoul ability, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Activate Gravespawn Sovereign by tapping five Zombies, returning Ghoulcaller Gisa from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
924-4149-4599-4871-7175.notes: If Phyrexian Ghoul starts with a power of 4 or greater, you can reduce the number of additional creatures you control. It must get to 8 or higher power before sacrificing it to Gisa.

2173-4496-5220-5933.description:
Activate Accursed Centaur by sacrificing it.
When Accursed Centaur dies, Mortuary and Popular Egotist trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Accursed Centaur from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Popular Egotist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Accursed Centaur ability.
Cast Accursed Centaur from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

4478-6738-7011-7082.easyPrerequisites: You control three or more Allies.
4478-6738-7011-7082.description:
Cast Razor Boomerang by paying {0} due to Sokka, Swordmaster.
When Razor Boomerang enters, Sokka and Suki's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When the Ally enters, Sokka and Suki's first ability triggers, attaching Razor Boomerang to the Ally token.
Activate the Ally token by tapping it and unattaching Razor Boomerang, dealing 1 damage to any target and returning Razor Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

341-3532-5078-7314.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Baxter triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

628-6797-7188.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Heirloom Auntie.
When Heirloom Auntie dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability
Repeat.

1887-6575-6774--85.description:
Activate Terra, Magical Adept by paying {4}{R}{G} and tapping it, exiling it and returning it to the battlefield as Esper Terra.
When Esper Terra enters the battlefield with four lore counters on it due to Vorinclex and Loading Zone, its fourth chapter ability triggers, causing you to add {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}, and then exile Esper Terra and return it to the battlefield as Terra, Magical Adept.
When Terra, Magical Adept enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to mill five cards and return up to one enchantment card from among them from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

280-5702-6664-6850.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn
280-5702-6664-6850.description:
Play Golgari Rot Farm. When it enters untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel, Golgari Rot Farm and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Holding priority, activate Golgari Rot Farm by tapping it, adding {B}{G}.
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Icetill Explorer.
Because of the additional Icetill Explorer token, you can play an additional land this turn. 
Repeat.

1170-1329-2079-3518.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard.
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by discarding your hand and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

24-593-6899.description:
Cast Wheel of Misfortune by paying {2}{R}, choosing an arbitrarily large number and having Wheel of Misfortune deal that much damage to Mogg Maniac instead of you due to With Great Power... if you chose the largest number.
Mogg Maniac triggers, dealing that much damage to an applicable target.
24-593-6899.notes: If you didn't choose the highest number, Wheel of Misfortune will deal damage to the opponent(s) who did equal to that number.

2558-5687-5688-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Skittering Precursor triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield as a 1/1 due to Judith, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Eldrazi Spawn.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent

3951-5334-5703-5744.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker, triggering its ability twice.
Resolve a Altaïr trigger, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it and creating a tapped and attacking copy of Éomer.
Resolve the other Altaïr trigger, creating a tapped and attacking copy of Éomer.
Put either Éomer token into your graveyard due to the legend rule, triggering the other Éomer token, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the end of your combat phase, Altaïr triggers, causing you to exile the Éomer token.
Repeat each combat phase.

1495-4120-6627.easyPrerequisites: Triskelion has a +1/+1 counter on it.
1495-4120-6627.description:
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter on it, targeting itself, but putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Vigor.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter on it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
1495-4120-6627.notes: You may also target your other creatures in step 2 to put +1/+1 counters on them due to Vigor.

2104-6308.manaNeeded: {6} plus enough mana to cast the extra turn spell each turn
2104-6308.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Conqueror's Foothold's fourth ability by paying {6} and tapping it, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

3604-5330-5365.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Clue token.
3604-5330-5365.description:
Cast Lonis by paying {1}{G/U}{G/U}.
When Lonis enters the battlefield, Cadric triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Lonis.
Activate Atog by sacrificing a Clue.
Lonis and the Lonis token's second abilities trigger.
Resolve the nontoken Lonis trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the token Lonis.
The token Lonis's first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the token Lonis's trigger from step 2, putting a +1/+1 counter on the nontoken Lonis.
The nontoken Lonis's first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the Atog ability.
Repeat from step 3.
3604-5330-5365.notes: You may optionally target any other creature using one of the triggers to put infinite +1/+1 counters on that creature.

277-1170-3389-5334-5954.description:
Cast Flickering Ward by paying {W}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
When the Everywhere land tokens enter the battlefield, Tiller Engine triggers, untapping them.
Resolve the Flickering Ward spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {W}{W}.
Activate Flickering Ward by paying {W}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

147-167-2921.description:
Cost Not Dead After All by paying {B}, targeting a creature you control.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Not Dead After All, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Not Dead After All.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield with a Wicked Role token attached to it.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Not Dead After All, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Not Dead After All.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, it and the Wicked Role token attached to it trigger.
Resolve the Wicked Role trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a Wicked Role token attached to it.
Repeat from step 7.

1494-5929-5974.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Numa triggers, causing you to pay {10} to put five +1/+1 counters on Sage of Hours.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

2797-4659-4853.description:
Activate Retrofitter Foundry's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
When the Servo dies, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Retrofitter Foundry.
Repeat.

2933-4068-4499-5798.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain
2933-4068-4499-5798.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Drowner of Hope.
When Drowner of Hope enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating two 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature tokens.
Activate the Eldrazi Scions by tapping them, adding {2}.
Activate an Eldrazi Scion by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite tapped Eldrazi Scion tokens, you may sacrifice them for infinite {C}, and then forego tapping or sacrificing subsequent Eldrazi Scions.

686-914-2892.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least ten artifacts and/or enchantments.
686-914-2892.description:
Activate Cold Storage's first ability twice by paying {6}, exiling Trusty Retriever and Dockside Extortionist from the battlefield.
Activate Cold Storage by sacrificing it, returning Dockside Extortionist and Trusty Retriever from exile to the battlefield.
When Dockside Extortionist and Trusty Retriever enters the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Dockside Extortionist trigger, creating at least ten Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve the Trusty Retriever trigger, returning Cold Storage from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate ten Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {10}.
Cast Cold Storage by paying {4}.
Repeat.
If opponents control eleven or more artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens and colored mana.

1165-3080.notablePrerequisites: An opponent controls a creature with less than two oil counters.
1165-3080.description:
Cast Exchange of Words by paying {1}{U}{U}.
Exchange of Words enters the battlefield, swapping the text boxes of Archfiend of the Dross and an opposing creature that does not have more than one oil counter on it.
At the beginning of the opposing creature's controller's next upkeep, their creature triggers, causing them to remove an oil counter from that creature and lose the game.

647-1328-3259-3294.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury and Spellbinder attached to different creatures you control.
An opponent cannot block the creatures with Breath of Fury and Spellbinder attached.
647-1328-3259-3294.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creatures that have Spellbinder and Breath of Fury attached.
Spellbinder and Breath of Fury trigger.
Resolve the Spellbinder trigger, casting a copy of Exotic Pets without paying its mana cost.
Resolve the copy of Exotic Pets, creating two 1/1 Fish creature tokens.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, attach Breath of Fury to a Fish token, untap all creatures you control and get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

150-215-2167-2404.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures.
150-215-2167-2404.description:
Activate Gaea's Cradle by tapping it, adding at least six {G}.
Activate Squandered Resources by sacrificing Gaea's Cradle, adding {G}.
Titania's second ability triggers, creating a 5/3 Elemental creature token.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Titania from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Titania by paying {3}{G}{G}.
Titania enters the battlefield, triggering its first ability, putting Gaea's Cradle onto the battlefield from your graveyard.
Repeat.

1604-2011-5168.notablePrerequisites:
All permanents do not have summoning sickness.
You control a black permanent.
Opponents are unable to block and kill Najeela and Ith.
1604-2011-5168.description:
Declare Najeela, Bloom Tender and Ith as attackers.
Najeela triggers, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token.
Activate Ith by tapping it, untapping Bloom Tender and preventing all damage done to and done by Bloom Tender this turn.
Activate Bloom Tender by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Najeela by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, untapping all attacking creatures, giving them trample, lifelink and haste, and getting an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat.

151-618-908-3572.notablePrerequisites: Disciple of Kangee does not have summoning sickness.
151-618-908-3572.description:
Pay {U} and tap Disciple of Kangee to make Kiki-Jiki blue.
Tap Kiki-Jiki to make a copy of Norritt.
Tap the copy to untap Kiki-Jiki.
Repeat.
Cast To Arms! untapping all your creatures.

3011-4522-4591.easyPrerequisites: Heartless Hidetsugu does not have summoning sickness.
3011-4522-4591.notablePrerequisites: At least four quest counters on Quest for the Pure Flame.
3011-4522-4591.description:
Activate Quest for the Pure Flame by removing four quest counters from it and sacrificing it, doubling damage sources you control will deal this turn.
Activate Heartless Hidetsugu by tapping it, causing it to deal lethal damage to each player with an even life total and nearly lethal damage to each player with an odd life total.
You cannot lose the game due to Platinum Angel.

3510-3703-5231.notablePrerequisites: An additional land card in hand.
3510-3703-5231.description:
Play a land.
Sporemound triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling token that is also a Forest.
Repeat step 2 any number of times.
Activate Thermopod any number of times by sacrificing Sporemound and any number of other creatures, adding any amount of red mana.
